title: Yochanan HaNazuf
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In [Shabbat 115a](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.115a.7) Rabbi Yose relates that Abba Chalafta visited Rabban Gamliel Beribbi in Tiberias and found him sitting at Yochanan HaNazuf’s table, etc. Hyman cites the beginning of chapter 3 of the Tosefta for Rabbi Yochanan ben HaNazuf. [Tractate Soferim, chapter 5](https://www.sefaria.org/Tractate_Soferim.5.15) omits the words Yochanan HaNazuf.

notes.text: Beribbi is an honorific attached to Rabban Gamliel. The Bavli names Yochanan HaNazuf. The [consulted Tosefta](https://www.sefaria.org/Tosefta_Shabbat.14.2) places the story at 14:2, with “ben Nozef” in brackets after Rabbi Yochanan. The linked Soferim has the Job translation episode without Yochanan’s name.
